summary: Wetour Robotics Ltd filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement on August 24, 2026, amending its Form F-3 registration statement. The filing reports the termination of its At Market Sales Agreement with Chaince Securities, LLC, effective five calendar days after August 19, 2026, and the related at-the-market offering. The company had previously sold 25,606,595 ordinary shares for gross proceeds of approximately $2.29 million under the July 6, 2026 supplement covering up to $50 million. This is a routine disclosure of an ordinary ATM facility termination, not a special situation such as a tender offer, going-private transaction, or issuer tender. No deal terms apply.
